verdicts.reason: Both drop the doctor illustration that carries the original, and both cram the six symptoms into microscopic, run-on lines that can't be read at 320x50. In A, the headline is large, but the #FLATTENTHECURVE pill and the 'Call your doctor' line are shrunk until they can't be read, and the text block crowds the headline. B's headline is smaller, and its big yellow hashtag box competes with it as a second focal point. B still edges ahead because its hashtag and yellow 'Call your doctor' line can at least be read.
